annotations.title: 株式会社インテルゲート｜intelgate,Inc.
InvGate - Build a state-of-the-art IT operation

content.text:
**“IntelGate” can refer to a few different things, depending on context:**

1. **A Japanese IT/web consulting company** — **株式会社インテルゲート / intelgate, Inc.**  
   It describes itself as helping businesses use the internet for content, advertising, marketing research, online services, and community-related projects. The name is a coined term combining “Intel” from the Italian word for internet and “Gate” as an “entrance.” ([intelgate.co.jp](https://intelgate.co.jp/?utm_source=openai))

2. **A software/digital solutions company called INTELGATE**  
   There’s also an INTELGATE listed on LinkedIn as a small software-development and digital-solutions company based in Gazimağusa / Famagusta, Northern Cyprus, founded in 2017. ([cy.linkedin.com](https://cy.linkedin.com/company/intelgate?utm_source=openai))

3. **A political-scandal label**  
   “Intelgate” has also been used informally as a “-gate” label for alleged intelligence-related scandals, including claims about manipulation of U.S. CENTCOM intelligence analysis concerning Syria and Iraq, and in some commentary around “Russiagate.” ([military-history.fandom.com](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Intelgate?utm_source=openai))

4. **Possibly a typo or confusion with similar names**  
   You might also be thinking of **InvGate**, an IT service management / IT asset management platform, or **IntelGuard**, a threat-intelligence service. ([invgate.com](https://invgate.com/?utm_source=openai))

If you saw “IntelGate” in a specific article, app, device, or political discussion, send me the context and I can identify which one it is.
